{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter completed orders only
completed_data = data[data['status'] == 'completed']

# Parse revenue as float
completed_data['revenue_numeric'] = completed_data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute average revenue within each customer segment for both channels
revenue_by_group = completed_data.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue_numeric'].mean().reset_index()

# Extract values for loyal customers
email_loyal = revenue_by_group.loc[(revenue_by_group['channel'] == 'email') & (revenue_by_group['customer_segment'] == 'loyal'), 'revenue_numeric'].values[0]
paid_search_loyal = revenue_by_group.loc[(revenue_by_group['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (revenue_by_group['customer_segment'] == 'loyal'), 'revenue_numeric'].values[0]
loyal_diff = email_loyal - paid_search_loyal

# Extract values for new customers
email_new = revenue_by_group.loc[(revenue_by_group['channel'] == 'email') & (revenue_by_group['customer_segment'] == 'new'), 'revenue_numeric'].values[0]
paid_search_new = revenue_by_group.loc[(revenue_by_group['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (revenue_by_group['customer_segment'] == 'new'), 'revenue_numeric'].values[0]
new_diff = email_new - paid_search_new

# Extract values for returning customers
email_returning = revenue_by_group.loc[(revenue_by_group['channel'] == 'email') & (revenue_by_group['customer_segment'] == 'returning'), 'revenue_numeric'].values[0]
paid_search_returning = revenue_by_group.loc[(revenue_by_group['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (revenue_by_group['customer_segment'] == 'returning'), 'revenue_numeric'].values[0]
returning_diff = email_returning - paid_search_returning

# Print all values to ensure they are recorded
print(f"email_loyal: {email_loyal:.2f}")
print(f"paid_search_loyal: {paid_search_loyal:.2f}")
print(f"loyal_diff: {loyal_diff:.2f}")
print(f"email_new: {email_new:.2f}")
print(f"paid_search_new: {paid_search_new:.2f}")
print(f"new_diff: {new_diff:.2f}")
print(f"email_returning: {email_returning:.2f}")
print(f"paid_search_returning: {paid_search_returning:.2f}")
print(f"returning_diff: {returning_diff:.2f}")"}
